purpose: Design batch: do the own-aircraft turnaround ADS-B features of dig tunnel 18 (docs/dig/pregap.md; 15 label-free columns built for every month and the ranking file by tools/build_ownpoints_features.py into data/external/adsblol/features_v19own) improve the shipped context-network member (configs/adsb_ctx3_combo_dev_v1.json: dl32 on ADS-B-matched rows, m25dl32 on the others) when they are network inputs? The same features already feed stack_resid_v3 (v63, built, not uploaded); this batch cannot measure overlap with that stacker (its components exist only for the four development months), so a GO here is necessary, not sufficient.
prior: Moderate: the stacker gained -0.16% equal-footing from these features with no context of neighbours; the network already sees the matched segment's first point / motion (27 ADS-B + 11 v19 columns) but never the points before the matcher's last coverage gap. Part of any gain will overlap the stacker's.
exploration_disclosed: Tunnels 15, 17, 18 (docs/dig/own_bounds.md, case_files.md, pregap.md) read these points against 2025 labels of the development months (January, July, November, December) through the shipped chain; no October label was read for them. The feature set is tunnel 18's 14 raw columns plus p_has_inb (its chain-relative columns are dropped: the network has no chain prediction). Nothing else was tried.
hardware: Azure arcw0-arcw7 (Standard_D16ds_v7), CPU, tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --device cpu --threads 8, two lanes per worker, as the combination batch; the controls (dl32, m25dl32, seeds 9-12) are refitted in the same batch on the same hardware and code; the 29 September fits of the same seeds are a reproduction check only.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design, unchanged: the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09, LIRF excluded), October monitored, October predictions only
protocol.inputs: controls: --extra-features data/external/adsblol/features_v19 (11 v19 columns), exactly the shipped member's inputs; own variants: --extra-features data/external/adsblol/features_v19own (the same 11 v19 columns, byte-identical values, plus the 15 own columns). The own columns are not masked by the m25 variants (they are observed on ranking rows whatever the matcher does).
protocol.never_read: No run of this declaration predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or of the ranking months. No official score enters. The published-aggregates sources are not read.

items.control: C = the dl32 seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, the m25dl32 seed mean on the other rows (the shipped member's routing)
items.own_all: X = the dl32own seed mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, the m25dl32own seed mean on the other rows
items.own_matched: dl32own on matched rows, m25dl32 (control) on the others (reported)
items.own_unmatched: dl32 (control) on matched rows, m25dl32own on the others (reported)

readings.pool: P = 0.5 x mean(ctx seeds 101-116) + 0.5 x mean(ctx_e24 seeds 117-132), seasonal-fold October predictions (as the combination batch)
readings.R1: October non-LIRF RMSE of each item's four-seed mean; matched / unmatched; by airport; identified-with-inbound rows (p_has_inb = 1) separately
readings.R2: recipe proxy (tools/nn_design_report.RecipeProxy, all October rows) of table = 0.25 committee + 0.75 [(1 - b) P + b X], b in {0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.0}, as % RMSE against b = 0; share 0.85 reported beside it

protocol.decision: own_all is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 0.4 (the shipped member weight) is at least 0.05 points below the control's, (b) its four-seed standalone October non-LIRF RMSE is below the control's, and (c) the paired-day 95% interval of the proxy RMSE difference between own_all's and the control's tables at b = 0.4 lies below zero. A GO goes to a separately declared development round (proposal only from this batch); without a GO the item is closed. The overlap with stack_resid_v3 stays unknown at this stage and is stated.

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)
